content.h2: Questions about fully managed VPS hosting

items.q: What is fully managed VPS hosting?
items.a: Fully managed VPS hosting gives your site or application a virtual private server, a reserved share of a physical server. Our team manages the server for you, with security updates, monitoring and backups. You manage your sites in a control panel. Root access is not included.

No. Managed VPS at DronaHost does not include root access. Our team manages the server for you, and you manage your sites in the control panel: Plesk, cPanel or CloudPanel. For a change at server level, ask support by live chat, ticket or email at any hour.

Your VPS is live within minutes of ordering. If you are moving from another host, our team then moves up to 10 websites for you for free. Your current sites stay online during the move, and nothing switches until you give permission.

items.q: Can my server grow with my site?
items.a: Yes. We can increase your server's resources as your site grows. Ask support at any time by live chat, ticket or email, and the team takes it from there. Support is open at any hour of any day, so you never wait for office hours.

No. Email is a separate service. Running email and websites on the same server can open a security gap for your sites, so we keep email on its own service. You can add our business email service whenever you need it, alongside your managed VPS.

Managed VPS is covered by our 99.99% uptime SLA, backed by service credits. If uptime falls below that in a month, you can claim a credit. The SLA explains how we measure uptime and how to claim. We also monitor your server 24/7.
